name: Yale University
summary: Private research university in New Haven, Connecticut. Yale College undergraduates live in residential colleges and choose from majors including Economics and Economics & Mathematics.

scholarships.name: Yale need-based financial aid
scholarships.eligibility: Admission is need-blind for every applicant, anywhere in the world; international students receive the same need-based aid as domestic students, including housing, meals and two trips a year.
